title: Juddho
description: A network providing the most modern combat experience for Bangladesh and beyond!
body:
# 🌃 Juddho Network
A Minecraft server and community dedicated to creating an enjoyable space for Minecraft combat and minigames within the Bangladeshi Minecraft community and beyond. Our server offers a variety of gamemodes for you to enjoy...

### 🎮 Games Offered
- Bed Wars

### ⏰ Coming Soon!
- ~~Wool Wars~~
- ~~Sky Wars~~
- ~~Arcade Minigames~~
- ~~Practice (Legacy Combat)~~
- ~~Duels (Modern Combat)~~

### 💾 Server Info
- **IP**: juddho.fun
- **Region**: Singapore 🇸🇬
- **Supported Versions**: 1.7.10 - 1.21+
- **Discord**: [Click to join!](https://discord.gg/GmptZQfBRa)

🎉 We also host a variety of **Weekly Events** with in-game prizes!
 
Are you ready to play? Join our server and enjoy a Minecraft experience on modern level!
